title: Tiny, cute bus
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- bus body -->
  <rect x="15" y="30" width="70" height="42" rx="10" fill="#FFD23F"/>
  <!-- lighter roof highlight -->
  <rect x="20" y="33" width="60" height="8" rx="5" fill="#FFE68A"/>
  <!-- front windshield -->
  <rect x="18" y="38" width="22" height="16" rx="4" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <!-- windshield shine -->
  <rect x="21" y="40" width="8" height="5" rx="2" fill="#C9EEFA"/>
  <!-- side windows -->
  <rect x="44" y="38" width="14" height="14" rx="3" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <rect x="62" y="38" width="14" height="14" rx="3" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <!-- window shines -->
  <rect x="46" y="40" width="5" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#C9EEFA"/>
  <rect x="64" y="40" width="5" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#C9EEFA"/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x="80" y="40" width="10" height="26" rx="3" fill="#F4A62A"/>
  <rect x="82" y="42" width="6" height="8" rx="2" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <!-- stripe -->
  <rect x="15" y="58" width="75" height="5" fill="#E8641B"/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="66" r="4" fill="#FFF7C2"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="66" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- tail light -->
  <circle cx="84" cy="66" r="3" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="76" r="9" fill="#4A4E69"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="76" r="5" fill="#9A8FBF"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="76" r="2" fill="#C9C2E8"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="76" r="9" fill="#4A4E69"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="76" r="5" fill="#9A8FBF"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="76" r="2" fill="#C9C2E8"/>
  <!-- cute face on front -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="44" r="2" fill="#3D2C8D"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="44" r="2" fill="#3D2C8D"/>
  <path d="M28 50 Q32 54 36 50" stroke="#3D2C8D" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
